question.question:
Use exact arithmetic. A share purchase agreement sets the headline price at 470 USD million. The net working capital (NWC) peg equals 11 percent of trailing revenue of 490 USD million. Closing NWC is reported as 85000 USD thousand. A symmetric collar of 275 basis points of the headline price applies around the peg: if closing NWC lies within the collar (boundaries inclusive), the price is unchanged; otherwise the price adjusts dollar for dollar only by the amount by which closing NWC lies outside the collar, upward when closing NWC exceeds the peg and downward when it falls short. Report the peg and the half-width of the collar in USD million, the signed deviation outside the collar in USD million (positive when closing NWC exceeds the peg, zero when inside), and determine the adjusted purchase price in USD million.

Answer format: return only the exact numeric value interpreted in `usd_million`, using finite-decimal notation when it terminates in base 10 and an irreducible `numerator/denominator` fraction otherwise, with no unit label or additional text.

slots.description: NWC peg converted to USD million from percent of revenue
Collar half-width in USD million from basis points of headline price
Signed closing NWC deviation beyond the collar in USD million, zero if inside
